title: Declarative residency dry-run & pin-conflict resolution UX + evidence preview API
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Build a developer-facing dry-run and preview workflow for Hosted API residency changes plus a deterministic pin-conflict resolution strategy. Deliverables: (1) a "dry-run" API that evaluates a tenant/residency manifest and returns the routing plan, impacted endpoints, and an evidence snapshot (preflight bundle) without committing changes; (2) console UX to preview the routing impact, show conflict candidates, and allow operator selection of soft-affinity vs hard-lock semantics; (3) an evidence preview export (signed, time-stamped bundle) that legal/compliance teams can inspect before and after applying pins; (4) a documented deterministic conflict-resolution algorithm and SDK header hooks so clients can opt into suggested fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run API accepts residency manifest and returns a machine-readable plan that matches actual routing decisions in staging
Console preview surfaces all endpoints affected and highlights conflicts with suggested resolutions
Preflight evidence bundle includes timestamped route assignments, decision rationale, and telemetry sample; can be exported as ZIP
Conflict-resolution algorithm and tie-break heuristics documented in Confluence and implementable by ENG runtime component
SDK/REST interface includes region hint header (X-Region-Hint) and a preview-only flag; calls with preview-only do not change runtime state
End-to-end test coverage: unit tests for algorithm, integration test validating dry-run vs actual pin apply in staging, and QA checklist completed
comments: 2025-01-14 Aisha Banerjee: Initial ticket created after compliance workshop. Problem statement: customers want to preview residency changes and produce evidence before committing. Linked to legal ask from Acme Health.

2025-01-20 Daniel Rivera: Design review scheduled. Asking eng for a deterministic tie-breaker proposal (region priority, tenant affinity score, capacity headroom). Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/residency/dry-run-spec

2025-01-27 Marcus Li (ENG): Proposed algorithm v1 in GH - runtime PR #4892: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4892. Uses ordering: explicit tenant pin > SLA tier > geo-affinity score > capacity slack. Raised concern about edge-case where two identical affinity scores exist across regions.
2025-01-30 Design feedback (Priya Shah): Console preview should show heatmap of latency delta and cost delta per alternative. Add 'reason' strings for each decision in the evidence bundle.
2025-02-03 Security notes (Dana Ortiz): Evidence bundle must be signed with KMS key and include audit trace; security review required. Added security_review_required flag.

2025-02-06 Daniel Rivera: Scoped MVP to include dry-run API, console preview modal, and evidence ZIP export. Deferring SDK deep-integration to follow-up ticket. Added QA checklist and acceptance criteria. Dependency added: ENG-78421 for runtime tie-breaker component.
notes: Trade-offs: we can implement a quick heuristics-based resolver now (fast) or a full cost-aware optimizer that simulates traffic (slower, more infra). MVP chooses heuristics with explicit override in console.
Telemetry: include a dry-run flag in logs and a sample of routing decisions (max 200 entries) to store in residency-dryrun index for auditability.
Rollout plan: behind feature flag; opt-in for 10 alpha customers + internal teams for baking; monitor mismatch rate between dry-run and applied routing for two weeks before GA.

Related artifacts: design mock (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/residency-preview-mock.png; Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/residency/dry-run-spec; GH runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4892
Follow-ups: SDK preview helpers (separate PM ticket), canary automation to detect dry-run drift, and legal-ready evidence signing rotation policy
